Owner-review data corrections (2026-08-09). F-05: the Drainage section re-phases from post-procedure to pre-induction/sedation — the drainage unit and suction are primed before the tube goes in. F-06 (owner option a): the four indwelling-pleural-catheter requirements leave the chest-tube template for the IPC_PLACEMENT procedure, which already carries them; CHEST_TUBE now represents acute chest-tube insertion.

The custom module composition offers the current module set, so it advances with the 2026-08-09 owner-review data corrections: Flexible Bronchoscopy Core v1.1 (bite block, airway adapter) and the v1.1 procedure-specific modules for therapeutic bronchoscopy, chest tube, thoracentesis, IPC placement, and medical thoracoscopy. No clinical content beyond those corrections changed. Scope note: the F-04 sampling-instrument zone/phase overrides are recipe-level composition actions on the EBUS and therapeutic recipes and do not reach this module-derived composition; a custom card selecting those modules retains the pre-correction sampling zones.

Codex corrections P91-C1 and P91-C2 (2026-08-10). The custom module composition gains an authored action channel (seed/custom-composition.json): sixteen per-slot composition actions, applied by the same canonical evaluator as the procedure recipes, each applying only when its target requirement is present in the selected modules. P91-C1 closes the v1-1 scope note: the six owner-named F-04 sampling instruments (EBUS FNA needle, FNB needle, mini-forceps, vacuum syringe; therapeutic biopsy forceps, BAL kit) now resolve to back table / diagnostic on custom cards that select their modules — specimen handling stays at the specimen station. P91-C2 applies the same two MED_THORACOSCOPY insertable-device placements (sterile field / therapeutic) to custom cards. Module list unchanged from v1-1.

Codex correction P91-C2 (2026-08-10). The v1-1 section-level F-05 re-phase correctly moved drainage preparation to pre-induction but over-reached on two insertable devices that share the Drainage section: the post-thoracoscopy chest tube (SLOT-57CA4B1298) and the optional IPC insertion kit (SLOT-9A1C0491F9). Per-slot composition actions now place both at sterile field / therapeutic, matching their governed home-procedure precedents (CHEST_TUBE SLOT-708736B8C2, IPC_PLACEMENT SLOT-1BCF3D0702). The drainage unit and every other Drainage row keep the v1-1 pre-induction placement; dependency rules, requiredness, labels, and option sets are unchanged.
